content.text: payments/notification_bridge.py: notification bridge retries indefinitely with no backoff on a permanent failure.

Summary: reviewed 16 files across billing/ and payments/. Three findings worth prioritizing: (1) the idempotency key TTL is shorter than a plausible retry window and can double-charge, (2) ledger writes aren't transactional with the charge call, and (3) the dispute handler logs full card metadata instead of a masked reference. The rest are real but lower-severity robustness gaps (backoff/circuit-breaker/dedup/timezone issues) -- filed as a punch list, not fixed in this session.
